name: competitive-programming
description: Competitive programming: single-problem solving, full-contest orchestration on any judge, shaping a problem idea into constraints and a subtask ladder, authoring Vietnamese problem statements, preparing testlib-based test data, validating solutions against a matrix of deliberately-wrong submissions, reviewing a finished package before it ships, end-to-end problem creation from idea to Polygon-ready package, writing a standalone HTML editorial for a finished problem when asked, uploading a reviewed package to Polygon through the bundled server when asked, and two bundled MCP servers, one for Codeforces and one for Polygon
